runs.headline: Sales reached 216.9K on 2026-09-03, with the recent period showing an earlier peak at 505.8K and softer trading through the following days.
paragraphs: This view focuses on how sales moved across the latest reported days. Sales were highest at 505.8K on 2026-08-21, then moved down to 213.2K on 2026-08-25, 202.7K on 2026-08-26 and 295.6K on 2026-08-28 before ending at 216.9K on 2026-09-03. The pattern points to a strong start to the period followed by lower day-level sales across most of the remaining dates shown.
On 2026-08-21, basket value was 25.5, transactions (bills) were 19.8K, and margin was 20.9%.
On 2026-08-28, basket value was 14.1 and transactions (bills) were 21.0K while sales were 295.6K.
Lower sales points in the period included 213.2K on 2026-08-25 and 202.7K on 2026-08-26.
The latest reported day is 2026-09-03 with sales at 216.9K.

The reporting period is day-based and the latest available data is as of 2026-09-03. The focus trend includes a caveat that there is no validated business time axis for the focus trend, so this summary describes the returned date pattern only.
